name: poster-control
prompt: 制作一张竖版深蓝色科技发布会海报，中央是精致发光的几何立方体。主标题“智能体新纪元”，英文副标题“AGENT NEXT”，三个信息点“更强推理”“更长上下文”“更低延迟”，底部“2026年10月18日 上海”。文字准确清晰，现代简洁风格。

name: poster-contract-a
prompt: 制作可直接使用的平面竖版科技发布会海报，深蓝色背景，中央精致发光几何立方体。构图：顶部主标题，下面英文副标题，中部立方体，下部三个等宽且互不重叠的信息区，最底部日期地点。文字白色，大字号，留足边距。画面中文字白名单：主标题“智能体新纪元”；英文副标题“AGENT NEXT”；三个信息区从左到右分别仅写“更强推理”“更长上下文”“更低延迟”；底部仅写“2026年10月18日 上海”。每段文字只出现一次，逐字保留中文、英文、数字及空格。没有其他文字、页码或标志。输出完整平面设计，不是纸张或屏幕实拍。

name: reference-product
prompt: Studio packshot of a single cobalt-blue cylindrical glass serum bottle. A smooth matte black cylindrical screw cap, a thin gold ring directly below the cap, and one rectangular ivory paper label. The label has exactly two centered lines: "ERIK LAB" and "SERUM 21". Front view, entire bottle visible, clean white background, soft neutral lighting. No other text, props or logos.

name: reference-person
prompt: Natural studio portrait, waist-up, of one fictional adult woman with copper-red tightly curly hair, visible freckles, round dark tortoiseshell glasses, and a mustard-yellow sweater. Hands relaxed and visible in front of her torso. Front-facing, neutral grey background, soft light. Photorealistic, no text, no jewelry.

name: panorama-2k
prompt: A continuous panoramic editorial photograph of a riverside neighborhood at blue hour, 8:1 aspect ratio. Left zone: a warm-lit timber cafe with three bicycles outside. Center zone: a stone footbridge and calm river reflections. Right zone: a leafy riverside market with red awnings. Consistent horizon and perspective across the entire width; smooth transitions between zones. No text or signs.
